svg.title: About
svg.desc: Section: About About me. CSE student at UIU, Dhaka. I build full-stack web apps with Node.js, Express and MySQL, and Android apps with Flutter. Most of what I ship serves the UIU community. I also write about tech at TechTalk with Sourav. B.Sc. in CSE, United International University, Dhaka, Bangladesh · Ongoing. Tech stack: JavaScript, Node.js, Express, Flutter, MySQL, C, C++, Java, HTML, CSS. Section: Pinned projects
